talents.panel.title: Talent Points
talents.xp.label: Talent XP
talents.explain: Every run pays this class talent XP: time survived, kills, bosses, metins and a win — more in harder zones. Respecs are free.
talents.rules: A row opens once 5 points per row above it are spent in its own tree. Milestones at 10, 20 and 30 points unlock a new skill.
talents.pool: Both trees share one pool of up to {max} points.
talents.doctrine.label: Run doctrine
talents.doctrine.note: Only the tree of the doctrine you pick for a run applies to it.
talents.tree.activeTip: Your runs with the chosen doctrine use the talents of this tree.
talents.tree.idleTip: These talents only count when you pick this doctrine for a run.
talents.reset.allText: All {n} spent points of {name} return to your pool. Respecs are free.
talents.reset.treeText: The {n} points spent in {tree} return to your pool. Respecs are free.
talents.row.label: Row {n}
talents.row.tipFirst: The first row is always open.
talents.row.tipLocked: Row {n} opens once {needed} points are spent in the rows above it in this tree — {have} so far.
talents.node.rowLocked: Locked — spend {n} more points in the rows above.
talents.node.noPoints: You have no talent points to spend.
talents.node.canRefund: Right-click or Shift-click to take a point back.
talents.node.canRefundTouch: Hold to take a point back.
talents.node.refundBlocked: Other talents depend on this point.
talents.fail.noPoints: No talent points left — play runs to earn more.
talents.fail.rowLocked: That row is still locked — spend {n} more points above it.
talents.fail.dependency: Take back the talents that depend on it first.
talents.mile.heading: Milestones
talents.mile.tipReached: Active in every run with this doctrine.
talents.mile.tipLocked: Spend {n} more points in this tree to unlock it.
talents.mode.label: Tap mode
talents.mode.tip: Choose what a tap does: spend a point or take one back.
talents.help.title: How talents work
talents.hint.title: Controls
talents.empty: This class has no talent trees yet.
talents.bonus.title: Bonuses from {tree}
talents.bonus.none: No points spent in this tree yet.
